newsitem.title: USA: Tobacco negotiators have draft of pact - paper.
newsitem.headline: Tobacco negotiators have draft of pact - paper.

text.p: Negotiators for a landmark tobacco settlement plan to take a draft of the pact on the road starting Wednesday in an effort to generate public support for the deal, the Boston Globe reported.

Public health measures in the package -- banning smoking in the workplace, eliminating advertising, requiring ingredient disclosure for cigarettes and requiring new warning labels -- are all agreed to and on paper, unnamed talk participants told the newspaper.

Backers of the deal plan to make a pitch before public health representatives in Chicago Wednesday as the first step in a process of winning support, the Globe said. That process ultimately ends with Congress, which must approve any deal.
Representatives for both the state attorneys general and the tobacco industry could not be immediately reached for comment.
